sources.title: GitHub - Helsinki-NLP/OpusTranslationService: Translation service based ...
sources.snippet: The service can be used to run OPUS-MT machine translation models, which are available for hundreds of language pairs. The OPUS-MT models can be further fine-tuned with domain-specific data (e.g. organizations translation memories) by using OPUS-CAT.
